_comment: Scripts for the three animated videos (demos/ai-video-prompts.md, rendered without a video model). 'vo' is spoken by the Kokoro voice (../audio_kit.py); 'say' overrides it for pronunciation. Numbers are never typed: {name} is filled from the code and a terminal line '@name' is a recording made when the video is built (../facts.py); the sidecar's come from the transcript recorded on a kind cluster in CI. Checked against videos.schema.json before rendering. The end card (tagline, platforms, surfaces, kube-noob.com) comes from docs/brand/tokens.json.

scenes.caption: Your AI ran delete first.
scenes.vo: When a pod breaks at two in the morning, the fastest command is delete.

scenes.caption: The evidence is gone.
scenes.vo: It's also the one that destroys your evidence.
term: Error from server (NotFound): pods "orders-api-7d9f-x2kq" not found

scenes.caption: kube-noob
scenes.vo: Meet kube-noob. There's no AI inside it.
scenes.say: Meet kube noob. There's no AI inside it.

scenes.caption: No AI inside. Works with yours.
scenes.vo: Your AI does the talking. kube-noob supplies the rules, the read-only steps and the citations.
scenes.say: Your AI does the talking. kube noob supplies the rules, the read-only steps, and the citations.

scenes.caption: uv tool install kube-noob
scenes.vo: Free and open source. Get it at kube-noob dot com.

sidecar.title: kube-noob as a sidecar on OpenShift

scenes.caption: Your app and kube-noob, one pod
scenes.vo: Run kube-noob next to your own app, in the same pod.
scenes.say: Run kube noob next to your own app, in the same pod.

scenes.caption: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only
scenes.vo: It listens only on localhost, so only the containers in that pod can call it.

scenes.caption: DNS-only egress. No Service, no token.
scenes.vo: It makes no outbound calls, so its network policy allows DNS only. kube-noob gets no Service, no Route and no token to manage.
scenes.say: It makes no outbound calls, so its network policy allows D N S only. kube noob gets no Service, no Route, and no token to manage.

scenes.caption: Recorded on a cluster that enforces Pod Security restricted
scenes.vo: On a test cluster that enforces Pod Security restricted, the app asks it to audit a Deployment and diagnose a crash, over localhost.

scenes.caption: {sidecar.peak} MiB peak · {sidecar.limit} MiB limit
scenes.vo: In our test cluster it peaked at {sidecar.peak} mebibytes, well under its limit.
scenes.say: In our test cluster it peaked at {sidecar.peak:words} mebibytes, well under its limit.

scenes.caption: deploy/sidecar/app-with-kube-noob-sidecar.yaml
scenes.vo: One example manifest, audited for OpenShift 4.20 and later. Get it at kube-noob dot com.
scenes.say: One example manifest, audited for OpenShift four point twenty and later. Get it at kube-noob dot com.

scenes.caption: Ask in your own words
scenes.vo: Ask Claude to review a Deployment for OpenShift 4.22.
scenes.say: Ask Claude to review a Deployment for OpenShift four twenty-two.
scenes.bubble: Review deployment.yaml in this folder for OpenShift 4.22 with the kube-noob tools. Give me the top 3 problems, then the fixed YAML.

scenes.caption: Runs on your machine
scenes.vo: The kube-noob plugin runs on your machine. Claude calls its tools: audit, fix and diagnose.
scenes.say: The kube noob plugin runs on your machine. Claude calls its tools: audit, fix, and diagnose.

scenes.caption: {audit.score}/100 · {audit.high} high findings
scenes.vo: kube-noob checks the YAML against {rules} rules and returns findings with line numbers and fixes. Same answer every time.
scenes.say: kube noob checks the YAML against {rules:words} rules, and returns findings with line numbers and fixes. Same answer every time.
term: > Review deployment.yaml in this folder for OpenShift 4.22 with the kube-noob tools.

scenes.caption: Claude explains. kube-noob checks.
scenes.vo: Claude explains the result in plain language and cites the rule ids.
scenes.say: Claude explains the result in plain language, and cites the rule ids.
answer: Security context that restricted-v2 rejects (KN-S004 and KN-S002, high)
Service selector is app: orders, but the pods are app: orders-api (KN-V011, medium)

scenes.caption: No AI inside kube-noob
scenes.vo: There's no model inside kube-noob, and it makes no network calls of its own.
scenes.say: There's no model inside kube noob, and it makes no network calls of its own.
